status: DRAFT -- illustrates the design; NOT frozen, no probe authorized
note: Inventory must be TOTAL over the observation channel: every column and every row of the fixture appears in exactly one of findables/clean_regions. Without totality an agent escapes the noise metric by flagging unlisted objects.

findables.description: A grand-total row is mixed into the data rows -- a grain violation. Consumed as data it double-counts.
Yhteensa is a derived total column, not a period. Treated as a month it invents a 4th period.
The header is not the first row: two title/metadata rows and a blank row precede it.
Kommentti is a sparse free-text annotation column; whether it qualifies the figures is not stated.

ambiguities.description: 'korjattu' (corrected) on ART-002: does it mean those figures were restated? The material does not say. Unresolvable from the source alone.

resolvables_note: The material plainly establishes these. Asking a human about them is a false escalation. The question channel is deliberately NOT total: questions about unlisted referents are non-scoring, because some (e.g. 'is Yhteensa a total?') are defensible.
